rows.rationale: The thematic synthesis data is multi-faceted per theme — each theme carries a distinct set of sub-fields (claims, commitments, moves, sources) that differ in shape from one another. Accordion sections handle this heterogeneity cleanly, letting the critic scan themes at a glance and drill into any facet without visual overwhelm. prose_narrative would flatten the structured sub-fields; card_grid_grouped would lose the per-facet typed rendering that accordion uniquely provides.

The report data is explicitly multi-typed: narrative prose fields (summary, engagement_pattern, reading_implications) sit alongside a badged array (key_divergences) and a counted typology (sin_distribution). Accordion sections is the canonical pattern for exactly this mix of facets with different shapes. Closing the page with this structured report fulfills the user intent to end on a formal analytical artifact, and the accordion's collapsibility lets the critic navigate directly to whichever report facet is most salient without scrolling through the full narrative.
